title: meta.pre_registration
description: The numerical changes the agent commits to before writing any code (README section 3, Stage B). Every interval needs a min and a max: an open interval never fails, and a gate that never fails is not a gate.

type.description: must be "data_change" when the change is meant to alter numbers, or "refactoring" when it is meant to alter none

reason.description: must explain in one sentence why the numbers will change; the Author reads it in review and judges whether the interval matches the reason

min.description: must be the fewest rows this change can add compared to production, as a whole number (negative when rows disappear)

max.description: must be the most rows this change can add compared to production, as a whole number

row_delta.description: must give both ends of how many rows the model gains or loses against production

max.description: must be the most primary keys that may exist in production and not in the new version; 0 means no row may disappear

removed_pks.description: must give the ceiling for rows that exist in production and not in the new version

altered_columns.description: must list every column whose values will change; a column that changes without being listed blocks the PR. Write [] when none change

min.description: must be the smallest expected variation, in percentage points written as a plain number: 0.8 means +0.8 percent, computed as (pr - prod) / prod * 100

max.description: must be the largest expected variation, in percentage points written as a plain number: 0.8 means +0.8 percent, computed as (pr - prod) / prod * 100

delta_pct.description: must give both ends of the expected percentage variation of the metric

min.description: must be the smallest value the metric can have in the diff's window, for a model production does not have

max.description: must be the largest value the metric can have in the diff's window, for a model production does not have

value.description: must give both ends of the value itself, in the diff's window, when the model does not exist in production and there is no percentage to predict; write it around the number in external_validation

additionalProperties.description: must be an object with exactly one interval: delta_pct when the model exists in production, value when it does not

metrics.description: must hold one interval for every metric in the spec, by delta_pct or by value; write {} when the spec declares none

then.description: a refactoring may not change any number, so every declared delta is 0

min.description: must be 0 in a refactoring: the row count may not change

max.description: must be 0 in a refactoring: the row count may not change
must be 0 in a refactoring: no row may disappear

altered_columns.description: must be empty in a refactoring: no column may change value

additionalProperties.description: must be pre-registered by delta_pct in a refactoring: a model production does not have cannot be refactored

min.description: must be 0 in a refactoring: the metric may not move

max.description: must be 0 in a refactoring: the metric may not move
